text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I call Narita Brian over so I can give her some fan mail.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: If that's everything, I'll be on my way.
choice_data_list: Aren't you going to read it?
Aren't you going to read it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: It's my letter. What I do with it is my business, right?
choice_data_list: Promise that you won't just throw it away, at least!
Promise that you won't just throw it away, at least!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'm just not going to read it here. That's all I meant.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'd never throw away a letter from a fan…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian carefully puts the fan letter in her pocket, then leaves brusquely.
